items.Sentence: The Facility is a membrane bioreactor (MBR) system capable of treating up to 50,000 gallons per day (gpd). The treatment system consists of primary screening using a rotating drum screen; a biological and tertiary treatment vessel (anaerobic treatment chamber for denitrification, aerobic treatment chamber for nitrification and membrane filter for microfiltration); a 9-channel UV disinfection system;
Biosolids are collected in a 50-gallon plastic container and disposed off-site. No biosolids are treated, stored, or discharged on site.
